text:
Sam: heads up — I'm out for a conference tomorrow 09:00-19:00 UTC and need someone to be primary for the 10:00-18:00 PST shift. Maya is currently secondary. There's a scheduled deploy around 11:30 PST and I'd prefer a 30m overlap for warm handoff. Can anyone take primary?
Maya: I can cover primary until 13:00 PST but I have a customer call at 14:00 and won't be available after 15:00. Not ideal for the 11:30 deploy if we need post-deploy triage.
Jordan: I can flip primary for the whole window if needed. I have a meeting at 12:30 but can reschedule. Happy to take it, would like someone to be secondary for the first hour.
Priya: I can be secondary for the day. Will keep DMs open and monitor alerts.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff checklist 
- confirm primary/secondary swap in this thread
- update PagerDuty rotation + Slack status
- ensure 30m overlap around handover and any prod deploys
- post runbook link for the deploy and escalation steps

oncall resources: https://redwood.example/runbooks/oncall

oncall-manager: Adding formal guidance: please ensure at least 30 minutes overlap and record the swap in the oncall doc. If the deploy is high-risk, request a staging smoke window 15m prior. Escalation levels stay the same: L1 -> primary, L2 -> secondary, L3 -> Eng lead paged via PD.

Sam: thanks — Jordan would you be primary and Maya secondary from 10:00 PST to 18:00 PST? That covers the deploy and gives me peace of mind. If Maya can only do until 15:00 then Priya can backfill.
Jordan: confirmed. I'll take primary 10:00-18:00 PST. I'll be @here 09:30 PST to sync with Maya for handoff.
Maya: confirmed secondary 10:00-15:00 PST. Priya will take 15:00-18:00 PST secondary.
Priya: confirmed 15:00-18:00 PST. I'll watch the dashboards and take follow-ups.
Aisha: I'll update PagerDuty rotation and the calendar event now, and set the Slack status for Jordan to "Oncall — primary". Leaving a quick checklist snippet here so the deploy oncall has it.

Checklist snippet to paste into deploy thread:
```
- Primary: Jordan (pager: +1)
- Secondary 10:00-15:00: Maya
- Secondary 15:00-18:00: Priya
- Deploy time: 11:30 PST (target)
- Smoke test: 11:15-11:25 PST staging
- Escalation: L1=Primary -> L2=Secondary -> L3=Eng lead
- Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/oncall#deploy-escalation
```

Aisha: PagerDuty rotation updated, calendar invites adjusted, Slack statuses set. Please ping me if any of these change.
Sam: perfect — thanks everyone. Jordan, please DM me if anything unexpected happens during handoff. :thumbsup:
Jordan: will do. I'll post a quick handoff note in this thread 09:30 PST with any outstanding items.
Maya: leaving notes for handoff: - open CI flakes to watch: infra/tests/rate_limit, - recent flapping in gpu-allocator-1 (see incident comment 1995004321).
Jordan: saw the note on gpu-allocator, I'll keep an eye and have escalation contacts ready.
oncall-manager: reminder to capture the swap in the weekly rotation spreadsheet so audit logs show who was primary for the deploy window.
Sam: done. Thanks team, I'll be reachable via email but won't be on Slack much. Good luck! :coffee:
